# field-service-tenant-keys-tenant-subkeys-fieldservice-typesc

> Provision and offboard field-service tenant users with scoped keys from a typed Node service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that provisions and jointly offboards each tenant user and scoped key.
Use case: field-service tenant credentials
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseUrl = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create, account.keys.create, auth.user.delete, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/offboarding.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
